items.html: And it is found that in the two years of the Yenika is the time of the absorption of the blood in the body of the infant, as Rabbi Natan the Babylonian said to that woman: “Wait until his blood is absorbed in him.” For it is the secret of the milk that is absorbed and spreads in him in the course of the time of the Yenika. And behold, the matter of this blood is this.
